zoe (prod-designer): Quick follow-up from hallway testing: people keep reading the routing preview as a status meter. They expect a single progress line not a distribution. Can we change the visual language so it's clearly a simulated distribution, not completion?
dan (frontend): Heard. My proposal: convert fills into thin, separated 'sparklines' with a subtle dotted background grid, move the percent to a dedicated right column, and add an explicit legend 'Simulated distribution (not historical)'.
maria (pm): Also, support tickets show the validation 'Overlap' is ambiguous. We should surface both rule names and a suggested remediation. Eg: "Overlap: 'Canary' overlaps 'Default'. Make targets exclusive or reduce Canary priority."
kevin (engineer): A few constraints: if we introduce sparklines we still need a 44x44 hit area for the drag handle. We'll implement visual-only height shrink and keep hit area via padding. Also, percent calc should be memoized by stable rule id to avoid recalculating on each render.
a11y-bot: :warning: Contrast scan: current cyan-on-white for tiny labels fails 3:1. Recommend neutral-900 for <14px UI text. Also ensure overlap errors are announced with aria-live="assertive".
zoe (prod-designer): Good catches. UX idea: add an inline micro-tooltip on the legend that reads: "This preview shows simulated routing distribution for the current weights. Toggle to show estimated samples (req/min)." Small 'i' icon.
dan (frontend): For keyboard and focus: when toggling to 'samples' mode we trigger a backend call for est.req/min which causes layout shifts and loses focus. We'll preserve focused rule id before fetch and restore after render. Also will debounce the backend call while user edits for 500ms.
maria (pm): Microcopy batch (short and prescriptive):
- Overlap: "Rule 'Canary' overlaps 'Default'. Make targets mutually exclusive or lower 'Canary' priority."
- Unsupported: "Target 'eu-west-9' unsupported. Edit or remove."
- Preview stale: "Preview is out of date. Run preview to validate changes."
kevin (engineer): Implementation snippet I'll use for percent calc: ```const total = rules.reduce((s,r)=>s+r.weight,0); const pct = Math.round((r.weight/total)*100);``` We'll cache pct by rule.id. Also will use a TTL of 60s for sample-rate cache.
a11y-bot: :white_check_mark: Recommendation: ensure all interactive controls have visible focus rings, enforce 4.5:1 contrast for small text, and add aria-describedby linking the error to the affected rule rows.
zoe (prod-designer): I'll update the Figma frames with sparklines, right-column percent, the legend tooltip, and token swaps for contrast. Will include a11y notes on the frame.
dan (frontend): I'll prototype CSS vars: `--preview-line-h:6px; --preview-handle-hit:44px; --preview-gap:12px;` and the debounce + focus-restore logic. Expect PR WIP tomorrow.
maria (pm): Thanks everyone. Kevin, can you pair for a quick copy sanity-check after the prototype lands?
kevin (engineer): Yes, 15m after your ping works.
zoe (prod-designer): Great 496 I'll post the Figma link and a short copy list once frames are uploaded. Thanks! :sparkles:
